scripts.build: pnpm exec tsc && pnpm exec tsc-alias
scripts.batch: APP_ENVIRONMENT=localstackTest ENABLE_NOTIFICATION=false npx ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register src/container_main.ts
scripts.docker:build:local: DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 docker build --secret id=github_token,env=NODE_AUTH_TOKEN -t politopics-recap:local-test -f fargate-image/Dockerfile.local .
scripts.docker:build:prod: DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 docker build --secret id=github_token,env=NODE_AUTH_TOKEN -t politopics-recap:prod -f fargate-image/Dockerfile.prod .
scripts.docker:build:stage: DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 docker build --secret id=github_token,env=NODE_AUTH_TOKEN -t politopics-recap:stage -f fargate-image/Dockerfile.stage .
scripts.docker:batch:local: docker run --init --rm --network politopics_default -e APP_ENVIRONMENT=localstackTest -e AWS_REGION=ap-northeast-3 -e AWS_ENDPOINT_URL=http://localstack:4566 -e AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=test -e AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=test -e GEMINI_API_KEY=dummy -e ENABLE_NOTIFICATION=false politopics-recap:local-test sh -c 'ls -R dist && node dist/container_main.js'
